In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the results of this thesis are in contradiction with the results of the adult studies and that the EMG patterns described for the adult population are not present in the pediatric population with NSCLBP.
EMG characteristics of NSCLBP in children and adolescent do not seem to be similar as those reported in adults.
EMG is not a useful clinical tool to discriminate children and adolescents with NSCLBP from asymptomatic children and adolescents, but further studies are needed to confirm this result.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the EMG patterns of the adult population are not found in children and adolescents with NSCLBP.
the EMG patterns described in the adult population are not present in a pediatric population with NSCLBP.
the electromyographic characteristics described in adults with NSCLBP are not present in children and adolescents with NSCLBP.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the clinical EMG findings in adults with NSCLBP do not seem to be reproduced in a paediatric population with NSCLBP.
EMG is not a reliable tool to discriminate children and adolescents with non-specific LBP from healthy controls.
